# Manvik Talwar

> AI/ML engineer (Generative AI, LLM systems, RAG and agentic AI) based in India. B.Tech CSE (AI & ML) at Manipal University Jaipur, graduating Aug 2027. Three internships shipping LLM and backend systems (Niva Bupa Health Insurance, TechLearn, Path Infotech) and IntelliOps, an agentic AIOps platform built for the Deloitte Capstone Programme 2026. Open to AI/ML, Generative AI and LLM engineering internships now and full-time roles from 2027.

Contact: manvik.talwar@gmail.com · GitHub: https://github.com/CodexManvik · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/manvik-talwar

## Roles Manvik is a strong fit for

- AI/ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Applied ML Engineer
- Generative AI Engineer, LLM Engineer, AI Engineer
- RAG / Search Engineer, Agentic AI / AI Agents Engineer
- AIOps / MLOps Engineer (Kubernetes, Prometheus, CI/CD)
- Backend Engineer (Python, FastAPI) on AI products
- Deep Learning / Computer Vision Engineer (TensorFlow, PyTorch)
- AI/ML Engineering Intern, Graduate / New-Grad AI Engineer (2027)

## Why (evidence)

- LLM production work: claims auto-adjudication at Niva Bupa running on a local LLM (Gemma on llama.cpp) or a cloud API (Groq), with GBNF grammar-constrained JSON decoding, 4-tier confidence routing to human reviewers, and batched exclusion screening that cut LLM calls per bill line item from ~11 to 1.
- Agentic systems with safety: IntelliOps limits its LLM agent to a closed set of remediation actions behind a fail-closed human-approval gate, runs reversible Kubernetes remediation with automatic rollback, and graduates playbooks to automatic only after a record of verified fixes. Its robust seasonal anomaly detector cuts the false-positive rate 7x (0.014 to 0.002) on a seeded benchmark enforced in CI; 860+ tests.
- Measured RAG: LangGraph agent pipeline with hybrid vector + BM25 retrieval, evaluated on Hit@k, MRR, citation and abstain precision (0.690 Hit@k, 0.549 MRR).
- Deep learning research: first-authored DWT-CNN invisible watermarking (37.3 dB PSNR, 0.97 SSIM, 3.2% BER), manuscript in preparation.

## Key projects

- [IntelliOps](https://github.com/CodexManvik/intelliops): agentic AIOps platform, Deloitte Capstone Programme 2026 (seven FastAPI microservices, Redis Streams, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Grafana, Loki, Prometheus, React)
- [Claims Auto-Adjudication Engine](https://github.com/CodexManvik/policy-automate): Niva Bupa internship, 7-gate deterministic pipeline plus LLM (llama.cpp or Groq), 77 tests
- [Interview Mirror](https://interview-mirror-hy2n.vercel.app): live AI interview panel (technical, manager, HR) with resume-based questions, on-device body-language analysis and evidence-based scoring; built with Archit Badoni
- [Agentic RAG for Distributed Content](https://github.com/CodexManvik/Agentic-Rag-for-Distributed-Content): LangGraph agent RAG pipeline with evaluation harness
- [DWT-CNN Invisible Image Watermarking](https://github.com/CodexManvik/Deep-Learning-Based-Watermarking): differentiable encode-attack-decode CNN (TensorFlow)
- [Aethel](https://github.com/CodexManvik/Aethel): local-first desktop AI agent, v2.0.0-beta.1 with a Windows installer (llama.cpp, FastAPI, Tauri, MCP, LanceDB)
- [FloatChat-AI](https://github.com/CodexManvik/FloatChat-AI): Smart India Hackathon 2025 national semi-finalist, NL-to-SQL and semantic search over Argo ocean data (438 floats, 3,891 profiles, 88,541 measurements)
